run_group_plot: run the group_plot script with a log_path to plot group statistics for a sweep of neuralfeels experiments
run_main_with_hydra: run main with hydra config to aggregate and plot experiment metrics from stats.pkl files
review_main: review the main function that collects experiment paths and generates timing, pose, and map error plots
refactor_main: refactor main to support multiple slam modes in a single plot run instead of one at a time
summarize_main: summarize the main function that orchestrates plotting of pose error, map error, and timing metrics per modality and optimizer
